info.text:
SoFi bought a whole bank for $22.3 million.
It started at Stanford in 2011 with alumni-funded student loans. In February 2022 it closed its deal for Golden Pacific Bancorp, which became SoFi Bank.
Year-end deposits grew from $7.3 billion (2022) to $37.5 billion (2025), and hit $51.3 billion on September 30, 2026.
In Q3 2026, deposits cost 1.45 points less than warehouse funding. Our math: $145 a year saved per $10,000 lent. Net interest income was $929.5 million that quarter.
Sources: SoFi 10-K filings (2022, 2024), SoFi Q4 2025 and Q3 2026 earnings releases.
News and education, not financial advice.
